meaning: Optional visual_candidate_details is false by default and explicitly enabled by the Week6 role-model configuration. Current non-message action context selects anonymous_without_ocr contours by geometry only:96x24minimum,8regions/1Mtotalpixels,reading order; no goal/target word or native reply selects a crop. Original screenshot remains first, original pixels/current IDs/bounds/SHA are logged; no OCR, painting, coordinate-space change or extra model dispatch. Empty region set retains prior format. Nonempty detail requests use a compact canonical-current-ID generation schema; secondary target aliases cannot select another target. This profile does not claim label/ID semantic agreement: original runtime consistency/freshness/scope and task-verification guards are unchanged. Independent auditor rebuilds crop selection and hashes from the actual scoped snapshot/pixels. SDK tests inspect actual encoded image bytes in one HTTP request and wrong-readable-ID refusal before any input. Caller semantic protocol,repairv5,whole-final guard,budgets,model and OCR profile unchanged. Saved development positive is not live acceptance or a heldout accuracy measurement. No old perception timing is attributed to the added vision attachments; actual task wall time includes their overhead.
limitations: Only large current anonymous contours receive details, subject to count/pixel limits. Detection/OCR may omit controls, native model may still select incorrectly; unchanged guard and actual event/pixel review remain necessary.
